Title: Branch-and-prune for the discretizable molecular distance geometry problem
Abstract: We study the discretizable molecular distance geometry problem and propose a branch-and-prune algorithm exploiting symmetries, with applications to protein structure determination from NMR data.

Title: Deep learning for crop yield prediction from satellite imagery
Abstract: Convolutional networks are trained on multispectral satellite images to predict maize yield across regions.
